meta.name: add-webex
meta.description: Add Webex channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 在应用中集成Webex聊天频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在应用里接入Webex聊天功能。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Webex chat into your app.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Webex chat to your app.

howto.what: 给代码库加 Webex 渠道：复制适配器、注册频道、装依赖并跑构建和测试，再引导你建 bot、配 webhook、写 .env。
howto.when: 当你说要给项目添加 Webex 渠道，或要求与 Webex 对接时。

say.text: 帮我把 Webex 加为聊天渠道。
say.note: 复制适配器、注册并安装依赖。

say.text: 我需要接入 Webex，请执行 add-webex。
say.note: 会复制注册适配器，再向你索取 bot token。

say.text: 安装 Webex 集成并跑通它的注册测试。
say.note: 会构建项目并运行集成测试验证。

howto.what_en: Adds Webex channel support to the codebase: copies the adapter, registers it, installs the pinned dependency, builds, and runs an integration test; then guides you through bot creation, webhook setup, and saving credentials to .env.
howto.when_en: Activates when you ask to add a Webex channel or connect Webex to NanoClaw.

say_en.text: Help me add Webex as a chat channel.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, registers it, installs the dependency.

say_en.text: I need Webex support — run add-webex.
say_en.note: Claude copies/registers the adapter, then asks bot token.

say_en.text: Install the Webex integration and pass its registration test.
say_en.note: Builds the project and runs the integration test.
